thesis: The episode introduces Ali Hamed, a 26-year-old co-founder of Co-Venture, who identifies and invests in novel assets at the intersection of technology and finance. His firm operates a pre-seed venture capital fund, a direct lending fund, and a crypto asset business, each with a creative twist on its market.
